atAGlance: Nem rán is northern fried spring rolls, usually with pork, glass noodles, wood ear, crisp wrapper, lettuce, and sweet-sour fish-sauce dip.
whatItIs: Nem rán are northern fried spring rolls, often filled with pork, glass noodles, wood ear mushroom, and vegetables, then served with herbs and fish-sauce dip.
howToEnjoy: Wrap a piece in herbs or lettuce if served, then dip in the fish-sauce dip. Eat while crisp, before the fried wrapper softens.
howLocalsOrder: Order nem rán as the northern fried-roll name. Ask for no chili in the fish-sauce dip and use the herbs to balance the fried shell.
worthKnowing: Nem rán and chả giò can refer to similar fried-roll territory, but the regional wording helps you read menus from north to south.
goodToKnow: Northern-style fried rolls often include pork, mushroom, and glass noodles; dip lightly so the crisp wrapper stays crisp.
